title: ReproBAIT: Can coding agents build their own biological AI tools?
abstract: arXiv:2610.19810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly competent at leveraging scientific knowledge and existing computational tools to execute complex workflows. At present, little information exists on their ability to reconstruct tools when given limited descriptions of such tools. We introduce an evaluation titled ReproBAIT (Reproducing Biological AI Tools), which measures the ability of coding agents to design, implement, and train biological AI tools taken from published research across a range of information access conditions. The coding agent is securely sandboxed without internet access and receives training data, a fixed time and compute budget, and limited information about the tool to replicate. We then score the reproduced biological AI tool based on its performance (tool-specific metrics) on held-out data. translated_title: ReproBAIT：编码智能体能否构建自己的生物AI工具？
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在利用科学知识和现有计算工具执行复杂工作流方面正变得日益胜任。目前，关于它们在仅获得工具的有限描述时重建这些工具的能力，尚缺乏相关信息。我们推出了一项名为 ReproBAIT（复现生物AI工具）的评估，用于衡量编码智能体在一系列不同信息获取条件下，设计、实现和训练源自已发表研究的生物AI工具的能力。编码智能体被置于安全沙箱环境中，无法访问互联网，仅接收训练数据、固定的时间和计算预算，以及关于待复现工具的有限信息。随后，我们根据复现的生物AI工具在留出数据上的表现（工具特定指标）对其进行评分。我们评估了一组复杂程度各异的生物AI工具：ProteinMPNN（一种逆蛋白质折叠工具）、RFdiffusion3（一种全……）
tldr: 该论文提出了ReproBAIT评估基准，通过在受限信息、无互联网访问的沙箱环境中，衡量编码智能体设计、实现并训练复现已发表生物AI工具的能力，并依据复现工具在留出数据上的性能进行评分。
